تساءلت (form VI)
# تَسَاءَلْتُ (tasāʔaltu) /ta.saː.ʔal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَسَاءَلَ (tasāʔala)
# تَسَاءَلْتَ (tasāʔalta) /ta.saː.ʔal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَسَاءَلَ (tasāʔala)
# تَسَاءَلْتِ (tasāʔalti) /ta.saː.ʔal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَسَاءَلَ (tasāʔala)
# تَسَاءَلَتْ (tasāʔalat) /ta.saː.ʔa.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
